title: Rotational Quantization: A Robust, Improved Analysis for Particle Identification in Single Molecule Cryo-EM Images
content: Understanding the functional role of macromolecular assemblies inside the cell requires a precise localization of these assemblies within the cellular environment [1]. 2D Template matching (2DTM) is an object detection technique that has been formulated to identify high resolution patterns of biomolecules in a cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) image [2]. The method involves computing a cross-correlation (CC) value at each pixel location between the image and the template using matched filtering-based approach.
